_readme: The archived WordPress portfolio listings of cherry.vc 2016-2023 (one Wayback capture per year, the same captures wayback-pull.py reads), joined per company: the firm's own investment date from the 2016-2019 listings (data-invested epoch seconds, verified against known deals: Quandoo 2013-02, AUTO1 2012-09, AMBOSS 2016-12) and, separately, the 2020-2023 listing's data-chronological attribute, which is the company's LAUNCH year (Infarm 2013, TourRadar 2010), kept as launch_year and never read as an investment date, the 2016-2019 'Investment: Seed / Series A' stage label, launch year, founders, website, sector classes (2020-2023), the exit ribbon / 'exited' class per year, and every year the company was listed. Names as the site rendered them (several vary across years, e.g. Flixbus / FlixMobility, Freighthub / Forto). A file_list site source (config.json site_api) so the attributes reach the judge; the per-year listing evidence itself comes from sources/wayback/parsed/.
